answer: Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 9 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in quill and dawn lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the ferrous graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1107 impostors cost 1946 times the honest price and take 26 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
